description: Four-panel summary: AP5B1 domain architecture, appendage fold match, binding-site identity enrichment, ortholog conservation
code:
import requests, json, numpy as np, matplotlib
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---- panel A: recompute pLDDT live from AlphaFold DB ----
m = requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q2VPB7', timeout=60).json()[0]
pdb = requests.get(m['pdbUrl'], timeout=120).text
pl = {}
for ln in pdb.splitlines():
    if ln.startswith('ATOM') and ln[12:16].strip()=='CA':
        pl[int(ln[22:26])] = float(ln[60:66])
n = max(pl); pl = np.array([pl[i] for i in range(1, n+1)])

# ---- values computed by provenance/ap5b1/02,03,04 scripts ----
tm = {'AP-1/AP-2 beta2 ear (3H1Z)':0.684,'AP-2 beta2 ear + ARH (2IV8)':0.671,
      'AP-2 beta2 ear apo (1E42)':0.670,'AP-2 beta2 ear + Eps15 (2IV9)':0.661,
      'AP-2 alpha ear + FxDxF (1KY7)':0.648,'AP-2 alpha ear + DPF (1KYU)':0.645,
      'AP-2 alpha ear (2VJ0)':0.611,'gamma-COP ear (1R4X)':0.564,
      'gamma-COP ear (1PZD)':0.561,'ubiquitin, negative control':0.266}
ref_pair = 0.456  # beta2 ear vs gamma-COP ear, an accepted homologous pair

sites = [  # pdb, label, subdomain, contact_match, contact_tot, bg_match, bg_tot, p
 ('1KYU','alpha ear + DPF (SDPFK)','platform',3,6,20,202,0.0191),
 ('1KY7','alpha ear + FxDxF (SFFEDNFVP)','platform',5,15,18,193,0.0151),
 ('2VJ0','alpha ear + FEDNFVP','platform',4,12,20,196,0.0361),
 ('2IV8','beta2 ear + beta-arrestin DDDIVFEDFARQRL','platform',4,14,19,192,0.0556),
 ('2IV8','beta2 ear + IVF','sandwich',2,7,21,199,0.177),
 ('2IV9','beta2 ear + Eps15 SFGDGFADF','sandwich',2,14,20,189,0.463),
 ('3H1Z','beta2 ear + PIPKIg YFPTDERSWVYSPLH','sandwich',3,22,22,182,0.525),
 ('2VJ0','alpha ear side site PKGWVTFE','sandwich/side',1,10,23,198,0.715),
]
orth = {'L779':24.8,'F782':88.3,'E783':27.0,'W786':92.0,'D787':16.1,'E792':18.0,
        'E795':30.4,'W799':7.2,'V821':16.5,'C829':7.2,'R843':23.2,'E845':50.5,
        'G851':11.6,'R857':45.5}
orth_mean = 31.6

fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(15.5, 10))

a = ax[0,0]
a.plot(np.arange(1, n+1), pl, lw=0.8, color='#3b6ea5')
a.axhspan(0,50,color='#d9534f',alpha=.07); a.axhspan(50,70,color='#f0ad4e',alpha=.07)
a.axvspan(660,878,color='#5cb85c',alpha=.15)
a.axvspan(625,663,color='#999999',alpha=.18)
a.text(760,22,'C-terminal appendage\n660-878\nmean pLDDT 85.4',ha='center',fontsize=9)
a.text(644,12,'hinge\n625-663',ha='center',fontsize=8)
a.set_xlabel('AP5B1 residue (Q2VPB7)'); a.set_ylabel('pLDDT')
a.set_title('a  AlphaFold model AF-Q2VPB7-F1 v6: trunk, hinge, appendage', loc='left', fontsize=11)
a.set_ylim(0,100); a.set_xlim(1,n)

a = ax[0,1]
ks = list(tm); vs = [tm[k] for k in ks]
cols = ['#3b6ea5' if v>0.5 else '#d9534f' for v in vs]
a.barh(range(len(ks))[::-1], vs, color=cols)
a.axvline(0.5, ls='--', c='k', lw=1); a.text(0.505, 8.6, 'TM 0.5: same fold', fontsize=8)
a.axvline(ref_pair, ls=':', c='#777', lw=1.4)
a.text(ref_pair-0.01, 4.0, 'beta2 ear vs gamma-COP ear = 0.456', fontsize=8, rotation=90, va='center', ha='right', color='#555')
a.set_yticks(range(len(ks))[::-1]); a.set_yticklabels(ks, fontsize=8.5)
a.set_xlabel('TM-score to AP5B1 660-878'); a.set_xlim(0,0.8)
a.set_title('b  Fold match: appendage (platform + sandwich)', loc='left', fontsize=11)
for i,(k,v) in enumerate(zip(ks,vs)):
    a.text(v+0.008, len(ks)-1-i, f'{v:.3f}', va='center', fontsize=8)

a = ax[1,0]
lab = [f"{s[1]}\n[{s[2]}]" for s in sites]
sitef = [100*s[3]/s[4] for s in sites]; bgf = [100*s[5]/s[6] for s in sites]
y = np.arange(len(sites))
colm = {'platform':'#2e7d32','sandwich':'#c0392b','sandwich/side':'#c0392b'}
a.barh(y-0.19, sitef, height=0.36, color=[colm[s[2]] for s in sites], label='peptide-contact positions')
a.barh(y+0.19, bgf, height=0.36, color='#bbbbbb', label='rest of aligned domain')
for i,s in enumerate(sites):
    star = '*' if s[7]<0.05 else ('.' if s[7]<0.10 else 'n.s.')
    a.text(max(sitef[i],bgf[i])+1.5, i, f"p={s[7]:.3g} {star}", va='center', fontsize=8)
a.set_yticks(y); a.set_yticklabels(lab, fontsize=7.5); a.invert_yaxis()
a.set_xlabel('identity to AP5B1 across the structural alignment (%)'); a.set_xlim(0,72)
a.legend(fontsize=8, loc='lower right')
a.set_title('c  Residue identity at the peptide sites (green platform, red sandwich)', loc='left', fontsize=11)

a = ax[1,1]
ks = list(orth); vs = [orth[k] for k in ks]
cl = ['#2e7d32' if v>70 else ('#7f8c8d' if v>30 else '#c0392b') for v in vs]
a.bar(range(len(ks)), vs, color=cl)
a.axhline(orth_mean, ls='--', c='k', lw=1)
a.text(len(ks)-0.4, orth_mean+2, f'domain mean {orth_mean}%', ha='right', fontsize=8)
a.set_xticks(range(len(ks))); a.set_xticklabels(ks, rotation=60, fontsize=8.5)
a.set_ylabel('identical to human in 97-112 orthologs (%)')
a.set_title('d  Ortholog conservation of the mapped site residues (Foldseek afdb50)', loc='left', fontsize=11)
a.set_ylim(0,100)
for i,(k,v) in enumerate(zip(ks,vs)):
    if v>70: a.text(i, v+2, f'{v:.0f}', ha='center', fontsize=8, fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
print("panel A recomputed live from AlphaFold DB; panels b-d plot values from "
      "provenance/ap5b1/02_superposition.json, 03_site_tests.json, 04_controls.json")
